_doc: Heritable trait genes (M6, ROADMAP §3.2). Animals carry 0–2 alleles per trait (genotype); dominant traits express with 1+, recessive need 2. Each parent passes one allele with probability (alleles/2). mutationOnly traits enter the gene pool only via conception mutations. Mechanical teeth: when a donor expressing the trait is extracted, part tokens in the listed slots are stamped with it, and the physiology engine applies statBonus — husbandry and breeding both compound into combat. Adding traits must never require engine edits.

traits.name: Dense Bones
traits.desc: Skeleton certified to municipal load-bearing standards. Head and hide parts extract with +3 Armor.
